They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him…
His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”
The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “If these ordinances depart from before me,” says Yahweh, “then the offspring of Israel also will cease from being a nation before me forever.”
translations.bsb: “Only if this fixed order departed from My presence, declares the LORD, would Israel’s descendants ever cease to be a nation before Me.”
translations.kjv: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
translations.asv: If these ordinances depart from before me, saith Jehovah, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
